title: Dummy Backend: Todo Autocomplete
description: Build an autocomplete input backed by the dummy backend's /api/todos endpoint, handling filtering, empty states, and selection.

steps.title: Fetch todos for suggestion data
steps.explanation: The autocomplete will suggest todo titles from the dummy backend. First, fetch the todos once on mount using useEffect and useState. Store them in a todos array, and also track loading and error while the request is in flight.
steps.task: Set up todos, loading, and error state. Use useEffect to fetch from 'http://localhost:4000/api/todos' on mount, updating these three pieces of state appropriately.
hints: Mirror the data / loading / error pattern you used in earlier tutorials.
Use an async helper inside useEffect so you can await fetch.
Clear any previous error on successful load.

steps.title: Track the search query and compute suggestions
steps.explanation: Autocomplete is just filtering + UI. Track the current input value in a query state variable. Derive a suggestions array by filtering todos whose title includes the query (case‑insensitive). When the query is empty, you can choose to show no suggestions or all – here we'll hide suggestions for an empty query.
steps.task: Add a query state string and derive a suggestions array that contains only todos whose title includes the current query (case‑insensitive). When query is empty or whitespace, suggestions should be an empty array.
hints: Normalize both strings with toLowerCase() before calling includes.
Use query.trim() to avoid treating whitespace as a real search.
Compute suggestions from todos rather than storing them separately in state.

steps.title: Build the autocomplete UI
steps.explanation: Now wire up the UI. Render an input bound to query with a placeholder like 'Search todos...'. Below it, render a list of suggestion items. Handle three cases: still loading (show a loading message), error (show the error), and 'no matches' when suggestions is empty but query is non‑empty.

steps.task: Create an input bound to query with placeholder 'Search todos...'. While loading is true, show 'Loading suggestions...'. If error exists, show 'Error: {error}'. When not loading and not error and query is non‑empty, show either 'No matches found.' (if suggestions is empty) or a list of suggestion items using the todo titles.
hints: Use a single input with value={query} and onChange to keep it controlled.
Gate the suggestions UI behind !loading && !error && query.trim().
Render suggestions in a ul/li structure for clarity.

steps.title: Support selecting a suggestion
steps.explanation: A useful autocomplete lets users click a suggestion to fill the input. Track a selectedTodo in state. When a suggestion is clicked, update both the input's query (to that title) and selectedTodo. Render the selected todo's title below the list as confirmation.
steps.task: Add a selectedTodo piece of state. When a suggestion is clicked, set the query to that todo's title and store the full todo in selectedTodo. Below the suggestions, render 'Selected: {selectedTodo.title}' when a todo has been selected.
hints: Store the entire todo object so you can extend the UI later (e.g., show id or other fields).
Remember to update both query and selectedTodo on click.
Hide the 'Selected:' message until selectedTodo is non‑null.
